verdict.rationale: Weave exposes a REST Service API for programmatic access to traces/evaluations and supports OpenTelemetry-standard data ingestion, which implies some data could be pulled out via API in an open format, but there is no explicit documentation of a full data-export/download feature or guarantee that all traces, evaluations, and costs can be extracted and taken elsewhere. missing for 10: explicit bulk export/download docs, confirmation OTel endpoint supports export (not just import), no mention of data portability policy or full account data dump.
